new_rule.title: empty_function_body
new_rule.description: GDScript 4 parser requires every func declaration to have at least one indented statement (or 'pass'). Empty body — func f(): immediately followed by another func — causes 'Expected indented block after function declaration'. The error is reported AT THE NEXT FUNC declaration, not at the empty one.
new_rule.fix_strategy: insert_pass_in_empty_body — insert '\tpass' after func declaration; process all empty funcs in reverse-line-number order to avoid index shifting
new_rule.detector_function: detect_empty_function_body(lines) — yields (lineno, func_name, reason) for each empty func; skips blank lines AND comment-only lines between func and body
